# OpenDating

> Private dating without precise location tracking

A live browser dating app built around deliberate introductions, coarse location, private decisions, and end-to-end encrypted direct messages. Native clients remain pre-release.

## What it is
- Category: dating app
- Platforms: Web, iOS and Android pre-release clients
- Price: Free on the web
- Built for: privacy-conscious adults seeking deliberate introductions

## Key properties
- No email address or phone number required to create an account
- Browser recovery keys are encrypted locally behind a user-chosen passphrase
- Raw coordinates are converted on-device to a 5-character geohash
- Direct-message content uses end-to-end encryption
- Private likes — one-way likes are never public
- Private blocks and reports — enforced server-side, never notified
- Current discovery and matching services are first-party
- The web app is live; native store distribution remains pre-release
